profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at GE Vernova
profile.summary:
Leading-edge senior software engineer currently working in fast-paced agile environment at GE. Detail oriented; problem solver and versatile team player with excellent analytical, presentation and interpersonal skills with an aptitude to learn new technologies.

Knowledge & Skill Areas:
- Software Development Lifecycle			
- Object-oriented programming				
- Agile Software Development				
- Requirements Gathering & Analysis			
- Web Design & Development
- Technical & End User Documentation
- Software Testing & Troubleshooting
- Project Teamwork & Communications
- Problem Analysis & Resolution

Computer OS: OS X, Linux, Windows.
Languages: Java, HTML, Javascript, JQuery, MySQL, PL-SQL, PostgreSQL
Database: Oracle, MS SQL Server 
ETL Tools: Talend Open Studio
Other Tools: Apache Maven, Apache ServiceMix, JBoss Fuse, RESTful API, JUnit, Spring Framework

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborate with peers and technical leaders to plan, design, and produce the next generation UI using the leading-edge technologies and frameworks

-	Created sophisticated, imaginative and interactive user interface to demonstrate a real-time management of a power distribution grid
-	Designed optimized component based architecture by utilizing Angular framework
-	Designed and developed backend micro-services to support UI components
-	Evaluated requirements and initial mock-ups; made technology recommendations that supported optimal construction, maintenance and performance
-	Leveraged the latest UI technologies to deliver dynamic and rich user experience
-	Served as a technical resource

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead implementation efforts for end-to-end integrated mobile solutions through various stages of SLDC.
- Planned, designed, and implemented core features for mobile solution using leading-edge technologies.
- Developed Java based solution that allows end user to customize the installation of the OSGi platform. As specified by the business needs, gathered/clarified requirements and continuously improved the architecture of the solution. Contributed in the testing of the solution on different operating systems to ensure the quality and reliability of the solution.
- Utilized Talend tool to generate jobs in order to efficiently manage all facets of data extraction, data transformation, and data loading into various databases.
- Lead & implemented Java based solution to automate the generation of database upgrade scripts, eliminating manual work, specially with support for different databases.

positions.title: Edison Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed java and web based software solutions as specified by business needs
- Configured and optimized solutions to be integrated into any open-source integration container
- Contributed in comprehensive migration of existing integration platform to newer version of Fuse ESB platform.
- Implemented a web based solution, using PrimeFaces, that allowed user to dynamically configure LDAP settings.
- Planned, implemented, and documented functional test cases to help increase quality of software applications. Developed SQL scripts to test and improve the performance of software applications. Assisted with auto deployment processes and scripts.

positions.title: Software Developer I
positions.description: - Developed a C# based web application tool that would validate an account for billing estimation reads which proved beneficial to other developers in efficiently accessing the estimation errors

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
- Assisted the Undergraduate Program Academic Advisor for the Department of Health Education and Behavior as her Teacher
Assistant
- Helped in maintaining the college website with new course schedule and new syllabus every semester
- Helped organizing various events with staff secretary
- Assisted with clerical duties such as filing, making copies, creating documents, and running errands

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed iPhone/iPod application software using Objective-C for Walt Disney Company, Orlando, Florida that would enhance the park visitor’s experience
- Provided application loaded with Disney maps consisting of embedded information, connection to Twitter, and an embedded game app to entertain the users.
- Demonstrated the developed project in coolTech Event held in Tampa, Florida and the Florida Chamber of Commerce held in ￼￼Orlando, Florida

volunteerExperiences.description: - Contributed in painting kids playroom with underwater theme (100 hours of community service)

projects.title: Database Management Systems
projects.description: - Implemented web application that featured picture uploading and socializing functionalities.

projects.title: AI in Computer Games Project
projects.description: Codeveloped AI computer game featuring head tracking device navigation. Designed game graphics using Unity engine and assisted in developing scripts using JavaScript.
